integrity: The defining Rota-Baxter equations and automorphism group are reconstructed directly from the multiplication. Odd-characteristic orbit representatives and sizes are proved explicitly. A standalone checker exhaustively verifies operators, ranks, and automorphism orbits over several prime fields.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats the integral base-change model with product e1∘e1=2e2; its characteristic-two fiber is the zero algebra.
The automorphism quotient is internal to each fixed base-changed algebra.
A specialized or differently indexed finite-field computation may contain equivalent point or orbit counts.
title: Finite-field Rota–Baxter moduli of the nilpotent Jordan algebra \(J_5\)
